{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Imperial Codified Standards for Power Plants and Transmission Routes''''' was a [[Book/Legends|book]] published by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that set forth standards for the structural engineering of [[Power plant/Legends|power plant]]s and transmission routes. Facilities were divided into six different categories based upon considerations such as the size of a facility, its sustainability, the amount of power that a facility was capable of generating, the demand for energy by civilian and military organizations and how the energy was ultimately put to use. Two of the six categories were "[[Fortress class|Fortress]]" and "[[Citadel class]]," with the latter being the largest known category.
